source_text: Neonatal timing also facilitates higher uptake rates, as evidenced by U.S. newborn circumcision prevalence declining from 64.5% in 1979 to 58.3% in 2010, yet remaining far higher than voluntary adult rates estimated at 3 per 1,000 males annually, primarily driven by medical necessity rather than preventive intent. [149] [105]
